errors.text_span: for the Llama-3-8B model on ten NLP tasks
errors.evidence: This information is not present in the figure itself and appears to be taken from the context of the source paper. A description should only include what is visually represented.
The y-axis has tick marks up to 60, but the data for the 'Full FT' bar extends significantly higher, to approximately 72 GB. Therefore, the actual range of the data is not 0 to 60.
The bar for 'Full FT' is the tallest on the chart, extending well above the 60 GB line to a value of approximately 72 GB. 68 GB is a significant underestimate.
The bar for 'MTL-FT' is slightly above the 40 GB line, at a value of approximately 42 GB. 45 GB is a noticeable overestimation.
The bar for 'TAG' is just below the 20 GB line, at a value of approximately 19 GB. 22 GB is an overestimation and inconsistent with the visual representation.
The bar for 'Adapter' is visibly lower than the 20 GB line and also lower than the 'TAG' bar, at a value of approximately 17 GB. 20 GB is an overestimation.
The bar for 'Ours' reaches a value just under 20 GB, approximately 19 GB, which is the same height as the 'TAG' bar. 15 GB is a significant underestimation.

errors.text_span: significantly lower than the other methods
errors.evidence: This statement about the 'Ours' method is incorrect. While it is lower than 'Full FT' and 'MTL-FT', its memory usage (~19 GB) is the same as 'TAG' (~19 GB) and higher than 'Adapter' (~17 GB) and 'QAdapter' (~9 GB).
